about_the_game:
Combolands is a tiny roguelike citybuilder offering deep strategy in a bite-sized package! Grow your own mini metropolis: place buildings, unlock powerful synergies, and trigger cascading combos. With 21 possible guild combinations, Combolands offers strategic depth and a 'number-go-up' rush in satisfying 30 minute bursts.

Unlock new guilds as you play, each with unique identities, strengths and drawbacks. Every run will see you picking 2 different guilds to play with. You'll start with a brand-new, procedural map, and grow a tiny hamlet into a thriving city.

Break the game, refine your strategy, and build a city for the ages!

Features:

  • Satisfying roguelike blend of deckbuilder and citybuilder mechanics

  • A pantheon of 7 guilds with unique buildings and playstyles - pick 2 every run

  • Procedurally generated islands

  • 120+ buildings to construct your town

  • 100+ passive heirlooms to further enhance your build

  • Upgrades to manipulate your buildings' behaviour, and potions to manipulate the map

  • Recruit from 13+ city councillors, each with their own progressions and abilities

  • Work your way up 10 increasingly challenging ranks
requirements_minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500, AMD Ryzen 5 3600
